en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Haroun Bin Kharija, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘(It is) from the reverence that you greet (السَّلَامُ) upon the one you meet’.
en.sarwar: 12. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Harun ibn Kharijah from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
It is of humility to offer the greeting of peace to whomever you meet.”
